summary: npm package ships only a fake Cloudflare-challenge HTML redirector, no installer-side code path
details: The tarball contains only package.json and index.html. There are no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare lifecycle scripts, and package.json declares main: index.html, which Node cannot require. index.html mimics a Cloudflare Turnstile 'Just a moment...' page and contains obfuscator.io-style JavaScript that builds a target URL, copies the current page's query parameters onto it, and calls window.location.replace(...) — a browser-side open redirect. This code only executes if the HTML is opened in a browser; npm install and require() of the package do not execute any of it. The package appears to be phishing/redirect infrastructure staged on the npm registry rather than a package that attacks developers who install it.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
